text:
Maya (Marketing): Heads up — we're targeting Wed 2026-02-11 for the public launch of the Dedicated v2 rollout. Need final changelog snippet, docs link, and exact rollout timing for the announcement + webinar sign-up page. Also want a one-line benchmark highlight for the blog (latency / cost). Who can ✓ these by EOD tomorrow? :eyes:

Luca (Engineering): Working on the changelog now. I'll paste a short changelog that marketing can use and a longer internal one. ETA today 5pm PT.

Luca (Engineering): Changelog (short):
```
- Dedicated v2 serving: 2–3x throughput improvements and ~25% lower p95 latency.
- New autoscale with burst mode and graceful fallback.
- Prefix KV caching: ~30% token cost reduction on chat workloads.
```

Priya (Product): For rollout timing: plan is staged canary 9:00am PT Wed -> full rollout noon PT. Webinar scheduled Thu 11:00am PT. Marketing to publish announcement at ~9:15am PT to coincide with canary. Is that safe? @Sam

Sam (EngOps): I'm comfortable with canary at 9:00am PT, monitoring window 2 hours, rollback guard at 9:45am PT if we see >1% error spike. EngOps will run the smoke tests. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-v2-rollout

Jordi (Docs): Docs: publishing the Dedicated v2 doc page now. Draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/v2 (will be live after merge). I'll add a "what's new" bullet for the announcement. Need the final changelog wording to match.

ReleaseBot: Release scheduled: canary_start=1769175600 (2026-02-11 09:00 PT), canary_end=1769179200 (2026-02-11 11:00 PT), full_rollout=1769182800 (2026-02-11 12:00 PT).

Maya (Marketing): Perfect — we'll pair the blog post + benchmark graph (latency histogram) with the announcement. @Luca can you include p99 numbers and a short blurb for the blog? Also need CSV of benchmark to upload.

Luca (Engineering): Yes — quick table I can share now:
```
model             throughput  p95(ms)  p99(ms)
rdw-ggml          1200 tok/s  58       120
rdw-ggml-quant    1500 tok/s  62       135
```
I'll upload CSV to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/dedicated-v2-bench.csv

Priya (Product): Inbound leads routing: Marketing will create a demo form. Sales enablement doc needed. @Maya can you confirm which SDR pool this routes to? Prefer `enterprise-dedicated`.

Maya (Marketing): Yes, route to enterprise-dedicated. I'll make the form and webhook to Segment. @Sam, can you confirm API keys needed for webhook?

Sam (EngOps): I'll generate an ephemeral key and post in the secure channel. Also creating an ingress rule for the webinar registration endpoint.

Maya (Marketing): :thumbsup: Good progress. Timeline summary: changelog + benchmark by EOD today, docs live by tomorrow morning, canary Wed 9:00am PT, announce 9:15am PT, webinar Thu 11:00am PT. I'll draft the announcement and share in #marketing-drafts.

Luca (Engineering): Noted. Will ping when changelog and CSV are uploaded.

Jordi (Docs): Docs PR merged. Link will be final once CDN propagates.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, flag here. :rocket:
